summary: The splash_contestant mascot skinned to the engine's canonical humanoid rig so a Ragdoll component can tumble… sockets grip_r, grip_l, holster_r, sling_back.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.splash_contestant_ragdoll or place "prefab": "splash_contestant_ragdoll" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
